result.title: Stable Dimensionality Reduction via Isometric Centroid-Encoder
result.summary: Many supervised dimensionality reduction methods promote intra-class compactness and inter-class separation but do not explicitly constrain class geometry, leading to variability in the relative arrangement of classes across independent runs. Such variability limits the reproducibility and interpretability of low-dimensional embeddings. We propose the Isometric Centroid-Encoder (ICE), a supervised dimensionality reduction framework in which class centroids are learned directly in the latent space while preserving a prescribed pairwise class-centroid geometry. Unlike existing centroid- or prototype-based methods that primarily encourage intra-class compactness, ICE explicitly regularizes the relative arrangement of latent class centroids. Unlike multidimensional scaling and many metric-learning approaches that preserve sample-level relationships, ICE operates on class centroids, preserving inter-class geometry without requiring large numbers of sample-pair or triplet constraints. We further show that the intrinsic dimensionality required to represent the centroid-distance configuration of $M$ classes is at most $M-1$, explaining the observed saturation of distance-preservation measures as the latent dimensionality increases. To quantify embedding reproducibility, we introduce the Centroid Neighborhood Stability (CNS) metric, which measures the consistency of class-level neighborhood topology across independent runs and complements existing embedding quality measures. Experiments on image and biological datasets demonstrate that ICE produces stable embeddings with improved preservation of class-centroid geometry while remaining computationally efficient. Additional analyses of optimization dynamics, sensitivity, and preprocessing further provide practical insights into latent dimensionality and explicit geometry modeling for supervised dimensionality reduction.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Isometric Centroid-Encoder（ICE）：在 latent 空间中直接学习类质心并显式正则化类间质心的预设等距几何，给出表示 M 类质心距离构型所需内在维度至多 M−1 的结论，并提出 Centroid Neighborhood Stability 指标衡量多次独立运行的类级邻域稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 VLM 推理无直接关联，但其对 latent 空间几何约束、内在维度饱和以及跨运行表示稳定性的度量，可能为核查 latent 状态几何与相似度结构、控制表示变异性提供方法线索。
